title: Lane Family · Quick start
tagline: Ninety seconds to Memorial, Museum, shirt QR stories, and the 1891 book plates.
heygenTitle: Lane Family — how to use this site
heygenMotionPrompt: warm welcoming nod, colonial time-traveler guide speaking directly to camera
heygenScript: Hello. I am David Lane — your guide to this family site. Start at the Memorial wall for names and dates. Open the Museum for stories arranged by era. Scan a shirt QR code to hear an ancestor speak, or watch a HyperFrame story reel. Trading cards and the plate gallery point back to Lane Genealogies, eighteen ninety-one. Remember: Context is general history; Evidence is what the book and our records actually say. Welcome home to the Lane line.
heygenScriptShort: Hello. I am David Lane. Memorial wall for names, Museum for stories, scan a shirt QR to hear an ancestor, plates for the eighteen ninety-one book. Context is background — Evidence is what the record says. Welcome to the Lane Family site.
